preconditions.description: The height of the tree must be between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == h + 1 and all(1 <= a[i] <= 200000 for i in range(h + 1))
preconditions.description: The sequence must have h + 1 elements, each between 1 and 200,000.
The sum of all elements in the sequence must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: If there is only one tree matching the sequence, output 'perfect'.
If there are multiple trees, output 'ambiguous' followed by two tree descriptions.

postconditions.expression: all(parents1[i] == 0 or parents1[i] in range(1, sum(a) + 1) for i in range(sum(a))) and all(parents2[i] == 0 or parents2[i] in range(1, sum(a) + 1) for i in range(sum(a)))
postconditions.description: The parent indices in both tree descriptions must be valid and within the range of vertices.
